Name: Igniting Smite
Description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell’s duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity, and the attack deals an extra 1d6 fire damage to the target, causing them to become ignited. The target takes 1d6 fire damage each turn while ignited this way. At the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, the target must make a Constitution saving throw to extinguish the fire, taking 1d6 fire damage on a failure or ending the effect on a success.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, choose one of the following options for each slot level above 1st:
• The initial damage and the damage from being ignited increases by 1d6.
• The effect persists on one additional attack after its effects would end.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
